TRANSLATE.ABOUT_TEXT: Hey, I'm Davor. I've always been into tech and software development because I find it exciting how fast everything is evolving. The possibilities we have today and what's coming in the future really inspire me. I enjoy thinking up new ideas and turning them into something real that can actually help people. My goal is to build something meaningful that makes a difference in someone's life, no matter how big or small. Coding keeps me curious and driven. There's always something new to learn, a new challenge to figure out, and that's what keeps it fun for me.

TRANSLATE.P_VIEW_JOIN_DESC: This app is a Join Clone. It offers user-friendly login, task management, and team collaboration—reflecting the core features of the original Join app.
TRANSLATE.P_VIEW_JOIN_DETAILS: I helped recreate the Join design from Figma, contributed to the JavaScript code, and collaborated with the team to learn and use Firebase.
TRANSLATE.P_VIEW_POLLO_DESC: Join Pepe on an action-packed adventure! In this object-oriented game, you’ll jump, run, and throw your way through challenges—collecting coins and spicy tabasco to take down the wild hen boss.
TRANSLATE.P_VIEW_POLLO_DETAILS: I used the design and information from the DA to help develop this object-oriented game.
